1. PRECONDITIONS: Emit a flushed start line. Authenticate source bytes, terminal sidecars and task authority. Check private scratch, tools and resources before work. Name missing external operands in gate_check_summary. Do not replace natural evidence with fixtures.

Poll owned children at least every 60 seconds. Use unbuffered output and bounded deadlines. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write files over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. No single huge tool call. Do not pad elapsed time.
3. Spec first: add relevant REQ-* and SCENARIO-* before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Reuse existing modules through small adapters. Preserve assertions, guard thresholds and old evidence. Keep scratch in /tmp and runners in scripts/experiments/. Do not modify research-roadmap.yaml. Freeze validation commands before measurement.

5. Authenticate current Exp8353 readiness, lease binding and runtime/library hashes. Acquire the existing exclusive lease, repeat only the immediate context/copy health check and abort on drift before loading. Confirm cache file/hash and GPU memory headroom; preserve unrelated workers. No generator training or driver operations.
6. Reuse the qualified V714 focal-tokenizer/intervention runner and frozen V713 request semantics. Load Qwen once, CUDA offload required with PID/device memory and layer receipts. Select the first12 label-blind eligible fit sources and at most36 original/selected-deletion/length-controlled deletion requests, max64 output tokens each, temperature0 and seed7138250. Keep answer bytes fixed. No label-driven selection.
7. Bound load at180 seconds, each request at60 seconds, inference at900 seconds total. Checkpoint after each triplet with progress inside generation polling; preserve all timeouts and intended units. Count model loads, generated tokens and GPU-active telemetry separately from cached prior evidence.
8. Require >=9 complete triplets, zero custody/cross-talk failures and authenticated live-GPU execution for bounded_canary_ready_score=1; readiness is independent of direction or magnitude of deletion effects. Missing support is a terminal null/block with exact operands, never fabricated completion.
9. Write docs/research-notes/v720-live-reopen-evidence.md with measured throughput and prospective separate fit/tune/reserved budget estimates. The V713 full study remains parked for a future plan even if this canary passes. These observations cannot augment the current CPU study after its protocol is frozen.

Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private scratch. Record argv, exit, timing and log hashes. Do not run the full repository suite inside this experiment.
11. Cold-replay primitive evidence in a fresh process. Run valid, negative and self-consistently rehashed tamper controls. Use unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep all findings. An exit1 requires the existing typed finding consumer: only independently recomputed informational findings with deliberate-error controls can resolve. Errors, unknown severity, warnings and critical findings block readiness. Do not edit those validators or exemption lists. Publish the terminal primary atomically after checks. Owned failures are disqualified; unchanged external blocks are blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind the invocation to its exact authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: honest_verdict starts complete_. Class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Partial means retryable unfinished owned work only.
gate_check_summary: principle: A block names upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed values. Missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Separate current work from imported inference.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Retain every intended unit and condition. Repeated timings do not add independent sources.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle controls use circular_positive. Both generalization scores remain zero on exposed development.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Readiness requires byte-bound checks, not scientific success.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Bind claims to measured work and replayable inputs.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported evidence and explain every added field.
bounded_canary_ready_score, triplet_rows, model_load_count, generated_tokens, gpu_offload_receipts: principle: Readiness means genuine bounded GPU work with complete units.
planned_substrate_class, actual_substrate_class, runtime_hashes, prospective_capture_budget: principle: A pre-load block has zero calls; canary success does not activate the parked full study.
